component/btn: Action trigger. Use a real button or link; variants (primary/ghost/danger/small), busy state via guardApply. Never a clickable div.
component/iconbtn: Square icon-only control for compact toolbars and rows; must carry an aria-label.
component/px-sw: The one boolean control for enabling/disabling an entity; auto-submits and announces.
component/menu-item: Item inside a dropdown menu; sentence case; destructive items carry 'menu-item danger arm-del'.
component/nav-item: Sidebar/navigation link with icon, active rail state and aria-current.
component/chip: Compact filter/selection token used in filter rows; distinct from badge (not a status).
component/index-row: Standard row for list/index pages: primary text, meta, optional actions.
component/tbl: Data table with sticky headers; collapses to card rows (.mcards) on phones.
component/bulkbar: Selection-only toolbar for batch operations; hidden until rows are selected.
component/savebar: Sticky footer for editors: primary Save plus Cancel; validation renders above, focused.
component/msg: Banner for server/redirect feedback; exactly ok/warn/err kinds.
component/toast2: Transient in-place feedback (one at a time) from the shared toast host.
component/badge: Compact status label (uppercase micro-badge); pair colour with text, never colour alone.
component/empty: Empty state anatomy: title, one-line reason, at most one primary CTA.
component/dlg: Native dialog element for modals/confirms; static-backdrop variant available; dialog is the confirm primitive.
component/tip: Tooltip for supplementary hints; hover/focus triggered.
component/spinner: Loading indicator for waiting states; pair with text describing what is loading.
component/field-err: Inline field validation message; form-level summary focuses at top.
component/tabs: In-place view switcher; roving tabindex + arrow keys via components.js.
component/cb: Combobox: type-to-filter select, optionally multi-select with chips and a mirror input.
component/dp: Date picker: text input plus calendar popover; min/max supported.
component/img: Image presentation with system borders; always alt text.
component/drop: Dropzone + file input for uploads; dispatches triage:files.
component/notif: Notifications panel with unread dot and mark-all-read.
component/cmd: Command palette dialog (cmd-k style) with input, items and triggers.
component/page-state: Full-page state (e.g. fatal/empty app shell) with message and action.
component/pager-num: Numbered pagination with page-size control; phone-trimmed.
component/tl: Timeline for histories (e.g. approval steps): ordered entries with markers, time, actor.
component/sheet-end: End sheet: slide-over dialog variant for secondary panels.
